strategy.text: (1) ATTACK? Yes likely. Candidate moves: Power Whip (2x on Crawdaunt, KOs — biggest fear), Waterfall (0.5x, ~29-35% at 252 Atk), Bounce (1x neutral, ~47-56%). Also Dragon Dance is very plausible turn 1 (Gyarados outspeeds). Not sure which; Power Whip vs Dragon Dance is the coin-flip. They see a Life-Orb breaker that 2HKOs them, so a KO-hungry Power Whip is likely; but DD-on-the-switch is also standard. (2) SWITCH? Unlikely — Crawdaunt is a scary target they'd rather remove/boost on than pivot around. (3) THEIR READ OF ME: they know Crawdaunt (Water/Dark, Life Orb, Adaptability) threatens huge damage; they'll either KO with Power Whip or DD to race. (4) MY OPTIONS: Knock Off is my best — 100% acc, 70-83% + item removal if they hold an item (Intimidate already drops me to 248 Atk; calc tool didn't auto-apply the -1, I corrected manually). Crabhammer only 36-42% (worse, 90% acc). Staying: worst branch Power Whip likely KOs Crawdaunt (they outspeed), but vs DD/Waterfall/Bounce I win the 1v1 (DD→I KO next turn after eating one +1 Waterfall; Waterfall/Bounce→I survive and KO). Switching to Scizor blanks their attacks (0.25-0.5x) but hands a FREE Dragon Dance to a faster sweeper — much worse. No hard counter to +1 Gyarados on my team, so attacking now to prevent the DD is correct. (5) MOST LIKELY: Dragon Dance or Power Whip. Response: Knock Off either way. Falsifier for "DD" read: they click Power Whip and I lose Crawdaunt. (6) SEQUENCE: I Knock Off (70-83% + item gone). If they DD, next turn I eat +1 Waterfall (~44-52%) then Knock Off KOs them; if Waterfall/Bounce, I eat it and KO next turn. Danger: Power Whip = Crawdaunt faints for nothing.

But most likely it DDs or Waterfalls turn 1 — moderate confidence it doesn't click Power Whip immediately vs an unknown lead. (2) SWITCH? It may switch only if scared; unlikely vs a Water lead it walls partially. (3) THEIR READ: Gyarados sees Crawdaunt, expects Water STAB (resisted) — may treat me as low threat and set up DD. (4) MY OPTIONS: Staying with Knock Off: OHKOs Gyarados (105-124%) if it holds an item (virtually certain) and removes it; if no item, 70-83% 2HKO. Cost of switching: forfeit turn + switch-in eats hit, no gain since Knock Off already threatens a kill. Crawdaunt is a strong wallbreaker worth keeping, but KOs Gyarados here. (5) MOST LIKELY: Gyarados Dragon Dance or Waterfall (I take 22-56% worst realistic). Falsifier: if Gyarados clicks Power Whip and is faster I lose Crawdaunt — acceptable risk since I likely take the Gyarados down with me only if I move first; if it's faster it survives. Actually if Power Whip KOs me first my Knock Off never lands. Still, Knock Off is the best expected play. (6) SEQ: Knock Off lands → if item, Gyarados faints, I get a free look at their switch. If no item, Gyarados at ~17-30% + possible DD, then I KO next turn / take a hit.
